about: 3.08 Stockway Pro v2 (Mandeep, 25 Nov 2026: 'okay apne suggestions ke saath V2 banao pura ek sath complete'). The numbers of live/pro2.py (entries), lab/chart_exit.py (exit) and live/early.py (09:20-09:30 breakouts). v1 (rules/pro.json, the Pro · Index / Stocks / Stocks strict accounts) is not changed: it is the control. Chosen on a 7-day replay with the real engine (tools/replay_check.py: 6, 9, 13, 16, 18, 19, 23 Nov; 17 variant accounts side by side; claude/v2_fusion.md) and judged on new market days: the accounts are paper, on trial.

confirm_main.why: Stock signals with a main-account PASS alert on the same stock and side in the 15 minutes before: +0.33R and 64% won (all strong), +0.50R and 71% with the strict checks; with no main alert at all -0.07R and 43% (7 replayed days).

no_stretch.why: Aseem's VWAP 2-sigma band as a no-chase check: signals already beyond it the trade's way averaged -0.02R vs +0.28R (4 of 5 days; inside the strict ones 0.17R vs 0.52R). With it the confirmed stocks + index (2 lots) went +Rs82,899 -> +Rs91,221 with 45 -> 31 trades and a worst day -Rs11,946 -> -Rs4,576.

pause_bonus.why: Ghanshyam's pause at the level before the break: +0.31R inside the strict signals (4 of 5 days, not proven): a plus point in the ranking, not a must.

midmorning.why: On trial (the variant test decides): 09:45-11:00 was the weak window (Pro stocks -Rs36K on 142 trades); a stock there needs a fresh break, not a retest. 7-day replay: no effect (the confirmed entries were not retests in that window); stays off.

same_side.why: On trial: 6 Nov, 10 confirmed calls on a strong up day, all lost. After 3 losses on one side the next stock trade on that side needs a fresh break. 7-day replay: no effect; stays off.

lots.why: 2 lots when the free money covers them, else 1 (stocks). The index account takes 1 lot (rules/paper_books.json): every index variant was flat or lost on the replay, 2 lots only doubled it.

exit.why: 7-day engine replay, the same confirmed stock entries (25), per lot: chart exit with the 10 EMA runner +Rs1,656 a trade (PF 3.49, worst day -Rs6,544 a lot), Trend Rider's exit +Rs1,422 (PF 3.18), Chandelier runner +Rs1,338, 5-minute-bar runner sold at T2 +Rs374. Selling one of two lots at T1 added ~Rs0 (so split_at_t1 is off: all lots ride). Index: every exit flat or losing (14 signals, 29% won).

early.why: Mandeep (25 Nov): 'kyi baar strong move 9:20 se 9:30 mein hi mil jaate hai'. A 1-minute close beyond the first 5-minute candle AND through a key level, with a strong first candle, gap and candle the same way, the right side of VWAP, the index with it (or the stock far stronger), order flow with it, a tradable option and no chase. 1 lot, its own account; the main account's 09:20-09:30 trades: replay +Rs44,767 (20 of 36 won), live -Rs20,474 (4 of 11). First replay (19 Nov) with the score alone: 64 strong 1-minute signals in ten minutes (the price-made checks agree on most breakouts), so the first candle's strength, gap and candle the same way, a tradable option and no chase are musts. 7-day engine replay: 1-minute trigger with 1-minute stop +Rs21,988 on 105 trades (PF 1.35, worst day -Rs3,330) but green on only 2 of 6 days (18 and 19 Nov carry it); 1-minute trigger, 5-minute stop +Rs8,327; the 5-minute triggers lost (-Rs38,721, -Rs47,988). On trial: the 20 live days decide.
